verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships its own background automation. Monitors automatically check connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP, refreshing up to daily, and integrations collect compliance data automatically and raise alerts on violations. Access reviews also send scheduled reminders and gather evidence automatically. These are product-defined jobs, though, not user-authored automations, and the MCP server only works on demand through an assistant rather than autonomously. Missing for 10: user-configurable or custom automation/workflow builder, scheduled or triggered agentic tasks, documentation of background AI agents acting without prompting, independent corroboration.
